decisions.what: Created styles.css with @import for Saira Condensed (400,600,700) and Exo 2 (400,500,600), :root brand color custom properties, CSS reset (box-sizing, margin/padding reset, list-style none), typography scale using Saira Condensed for headings and Exo 2 for body, responsive breakpoint tokens, and utility classes (.container, .grid, .flex, .flex-col, .items-center, .justify-between).
decisions.why: Spec 001 required a full design-system foundation with brand color custom properties, Google Fonts integration, mobile-first responsive utilities, and CSS reset.

decisions.what: Added an ARVAD marker HTML comment above the existing <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css"> in index.html rather than duplicating the link tag.
decisions.why: Spec 002 asked to add the stylesheet link after the favicon; the link already existed at line 26 (after the favicon and Google Fonts preconnect/import). Per rule 9, the marker was added while confirming the implementation, avoiding a duplicate link element.
